name: A Stack of Letters
summary: In Coldridge Valley, a stack of letters has come through the mountain pass for scouts in the snowy wilderness.

sections.title: Through the Pass
sections.body:
Letters for Coldridge Valley come from Anvilmar by way of travelers crossing the pass. The road to the remote camps in Dun Morogh's mountains is hard, so postal runners rely on travelers to carry each bundle onward. This one is bound for scouts deeper in Coldridge Valley.

Until the letters are sorted, Talin Keeneye at his lakeside camp is thought to be the only recipient. Among them is a missive for Grelin Whitebeard, a mountaineer.

faq.q: What is inside the stack of letters?
faq.answer: The bundle holds personal letters and dispatches for dwarves in Coldridge Valley. Talin Keeneye at his camp near the frozen lake is thought to be the only recipient until the letters reveal one addressed to Grelin Whitebeard.

faq.q: Who sends these letters to Coldridge Valley?
aliases: where did the letters come from
faq.answer: The letters came through the pass into Coldridge Valley and reached Anvilmar. From there, a traveler willing to carry them down the road took them onward.
The dwarf scout Talin Keeneye receives the parcel at his camp by the frozen lake. Looking through the stack, he finds a letter for Grelin Whitebeard.

angles.text: As a young mountaineer starting out in Coldridge Valley, you carry mail between snowy camps. The journey introduces you to Dun Morogh's harsh roads and scattered watchers.
